description: This file defines an Android activity for scanning and listing Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices, providing UI interactions for starting/stopping scans, and handling device selection.
external_files: R (resource references, e.g., R.string.title_devices, R.menu.main, R.layout.actionbar_indeterminate_progress, R.layout.listitem_device, R.id.device_address, R.id.device_name, R.id.menu_stop, R.id.menu_scan, R.id.menu_refresh)

Android SDK classes (Activity, ListActivity, BluetoothAdapter, BluetoothDevice, BluetoothManager, Context, Intent, PackageManager, Bundle, Handler, LayoutInflater, Menu, MenuItem, View, ViewGroup, TextView, Toast)

classes.name: DeviceScanActivity
classes.description: An activity for scanning and displaying Bluetooth LE devices, managing Bluetooth scan lifecycle, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, checks for BLE support, and sets up the Bluetooth adapter.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu and updates UI elements based on scan state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu actions to start or stop device scanning.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks Bluetooth enabled status, initializes list adapter, and starts scanning.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles user response to Bluetooth enable request.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops scanning and clears device list when activity is paused.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles user selection of a device, stops scanning, and launches DeviceControlActivity with device info.

methods.name: scanLeDevice
methods.description: Controls starting and stopping Bluetooth LE device scanning with timing.
